secondAuditResiduals.finding1ContextRevalidationBeforeRealPat: DONE — after awaiting storageClassApi.get, the execute path re-verifies operation generation, cluster id, request identity, executing step, approval gate and PROD context (canExecute()); any change aborts with no real PATCH. secondAuditResiduals.finding2FingerprintBoundToResourceVersio: DONE — approved fingerprint is now {operation, uid, resourceVersion, size, storageClassName} of the PVC observed by the dry-run; a PVC resourceVersion change between dry-run and execution invalidates the approval, returns to the input form with a visible error and demands a new dry-run (a real PATCH is never built with a newer version under an older authorization). The prior test accepting dry-run at rv 10 and real PATCH at rv 120 was rewritten: it now expects invalidation plus a fresh approved dry-run at rv 120; positive case asserts the real PATCH carries the approved rv 10.
secondAuditResiduals.finding3StrictBoundPhaseInMenu: DONE — Expand PVC enabled only with status.phase === 'Bound' exactly; missing/unknown phase, Pending, Lost and any other phase stay disabled (with the not-bound tooltip) while keeping the per-cluster StorageClass capability query and the denied/unknown/forbidden-403/unreachable distinction. secondAuditResiduals.finding4QuantityLimits: DONE — bigint arithmetic kept; added guards: quantity length <= 64 chars and |exponent| <= 32 (beyond int64 range cannot be represented anyway) with soft rejections and no unhandled exceptions for inputs like 1e999999999999; normal valid quantities (1e3, 1.5Gi, binary/decimal suffixes) still accepted; new tests cover bomb exponent, out-of-range exponent (positive/negative/sign explicit), 65+-char strings and a valid 64-char string.
